messages:
anika.sales: Heads-up: NimbusCorp wants to finalize POC. Procurement sent OF but wants procurement@nimcorp.com as signer and added DPA redlines + HSM attestation asks. OrderForm: OF-2026-0621.
rafa.legal: share their redline. HSM + data residency clauses are usually the holdup.
anika.sales: uploaded redlines to drive (link shared in DM). They also requested Net45 on invoice.
mike.se: Confirming POC config: Dedicated 2xA100, 14d. If they want burst, we need to include burst policy in OF.
sam.finance: Net30 default. If they push Net45 and ARR > 100k we need approval. Also need PO number and remit-to.
nadine.security: SQ flagged: syslog export to third-party SIEM and cross-account S3 replication. Opening SQ-799 to clarify if logs contain PII.
rafa.legal: Proposed DocuSign flow: sequential signers: procurement@nimcorp.com -> Redwood legal (rafa.legal). I'll prepare redline attachment and suggest Appendix A for any HSM vendor specifics.
docusign-bot: Envelope created env_7922 for OF-2026-0621. Link: https://docusign/redwood/env_7922
anika.sales: OF snippet for envelope: ```OrderForm: OF-2026-0621
Plan: Dedicated Trial (2xA100)
Region: us-east-1
Start: 2026-06-21
Billing: Net30 (pending)
PO: <pending>```
mike.se: If they insist on named HSM vendor, SE will run compatibility check. Might need SOW.
sam.finance: Please confirm PO and remit address before we countersign.
anika.sales: assigning owners: @rafa.legal = legal redline + countersign, @nadine.security = SQ-799 follow-up, @sam.finance = billing/PO, @mike.se = Dedicated verification. I'll update CRM.
nadine.security: Will DM NimbusCorp for retention and PII confirmation. ETA: EOD.
rafa.legal: If attestation is an ongoing deliverable, scope in Appendix B (SOW) rather than changing SLA.
anika.sales: thanks all 44d waiting on PO + SQ answers before finalizing envelope. End.
